verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Together AI hosts 100+ open-source models and supports deploying various model IDs (e.g., docs-2, docs-25), but there is no evidence about the speed or process by which newly released open-weight models are added to the platform after their public release. No documentation, changelog, or community report addresses time-to-availability for new model releases. missing for 10: any statement on release-to-availability turnaround, changelog/announcement of rapid model additions, or evidence of day-one support for new open-weight model launches.
